title: Record El Niño threatens Great Barrier Reef with ecological shift | New Scientist

author: James Woodford

title: The world may never go back to how it was after this monster El Niño | New Scientist
description: This El Niño is forecast to end around June next year after smashing all records, but its impacts could persist indefinitely in some parts of the world
author: Michael Le Page

description: The genome of Jonathan the giant tortoise, a 194-year-old resident of St Helena island, has been probed to understand how he has been alive for more than double his species’ average life expectancy
author: James Woodford

author: James Woodford
